# Vibe HUD

> Universal ambient status light for AI coding agents on macOS.

Vibe HUD is an open-source macOS desktop overlay (Python + pywebview) that
shows real-time status of AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Aider,
Codex, OpenCode — via a floating glassmorphic pill that stays on top of all
windows. It eliminates the need to switch back to the terminal to check whether
an AI agent is still working, has finished, or needs human input.

## Core concept

When an AI agent runs, the developer typically switches to another app and waits.
Vibe HUD solves the "when do I look back?" problem by providing a persistent,
peripheral visual (and audio) signal:

- 🔴 Red pulsing  → agent is working (bash, edit, thinking)
- 🟢 Green flash  → agent finished its turn
- 🟡 Amber pulse  → agent is waiting for human input / permission

## How it works

Claude Code fires lifecycle hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, etc.) defined
in `~/.claude/settings.json`. The `vibe-hud-hook` binary is registered as the
handler; it reads the JSON event from stdin and POSTs it to a local HTTP server
(`http://127.0.0.1:28790/event`) running inside the Vibe HUD process. The HUD
updates its overlay state in response. A file-based fallback
(`~/.claude-hud/state.json`) is used when the server is not running.

The overlay itself is a native macOS window (AppKit, via pywebview) rendered
with WebKit. It is always-on-top, frameless, transparent, and draggable.

## Repository layout

```
vibe_hud/           Python package
  cli.py            Entry points: `vibe-hud` and `vibe-hud-hook` commands
  server.py         Local HTTP server that receives hook events
  ui/               HTML/CSS/JS for the overlay pill
pyproject.toml      Package metadata and dependencies (Poetry)
README.md           Full user-facing documentation
AGENTS.md           Instructions for AI coding agents working on this repo
CLAUDE.md           Claude Code–specific context and conventions
```

## Key dependencies

- `pywebview >= 6.2.1` — native WebKit window on macOS
- Python >= 3.10
- Poetry for package management

## Quick start (for LLM agents helping users)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sahilbagnial/vibe-hud.git
cd vibe-hud
poetry install
poetry run vibe-hud          # launch the overlay
poetry run vibe-hud install  # register Claude Code hooks
poetry run vibe-hud simulate # demo all states without Claude
```

## Roadmap highlights

- Menu bar tray icon + native OS notifications
- Adapters for Cursor, Aider, Codex, OpenCode (multi-agent)
- Windows / Linux always-on-top parity
- Session history and stale-session detection
